# MemoryHooker

Local-first memory reminders and retrieval for coding-agent lifecycle hooks.

Version: 0.3.3
Last-checked: 2026-09-14
Ecosystem: ellmos-ai
Umbrella: open-bricks

## Important files

- README.md: Public usage, visual architecture, configuration, providers, backends, and comparative matrix.
- README_de.md: Deutsche Dokumentation mit vollständiger 16-Punkte-Anker-Parität.
- SECURITY.md: Private vulnerability-reporting requirements, threat model, and 48-hour response SLA.
- THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md: Audited permissive licenses (PSFL-2.0, MIT, Apache-2.0) and zero-copyleft guarantee.
- MARKETING-LOG.txt: Target personas, discoverability keywords, and comparative matrix audit.
- PROVENANCE.md: Clean-history and BACH lineage statement.
- memoryhooker/config.py: Configuration schema, mode definitions, and safe defaults.
- memoryhooker/backends/: Local read-only retrieval adapters (USMC, Gardener, Files, BACH).
- memoryhooker/providers/: Host-specific snippet generators (Claude Code, Codex, Kimi, Antigravity, Git, manual).
- tests/: 180+ automated behavior, metadata parity, privacy sanitization, and provider-contract tests.

## Safety properties

- The package performs no network requests (100% Zero-Egress).
- Host configuration is never edited automatically (`install-snippet` prints manual instructions).
- The Gardener and USMC backends open configured databases strictly read-only (`mode=ro`).
- Deterministic privacy boundary redacts secret tokens and absolute paths before emission.
- Session cap, cooldown, and calendar-day TTL prevent runaway injection loops.
- Unavailable backends fail open and produce no hits without disrupting the agent harness.
